svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Four questions about one residue
svg.desc: Four questions about one residue. Each is answered by a checked step in ChannelScope, with its counts in version 0.1; the answers meet at the residue, side by side, with no verdict. Which residue is it in rabbit, mouse and pig? (Result 1): Mapping between species, all 5,038 human residues, each map checked; rabbit's against published pairs; Which residue is it inside each structure? (Result 2): Numbering checked against UniProt, 26 structures: 20 two ways, 6 by the alignment alone, in 5 of them, one stretch numbered one off; Is each structure open or closed at the gate? (Result 3): The gate ring's clearance, 26 structures: 14 closed, 12 open, none between, measured by two implementations; What else is recorded at the residue? (Result 4): gnomAD's variants, ClinVar's records, 624 variants at 260 of the 299 residues; 358 expert-panel records at 299 residues, 222 of uncertain significance, each as retrieved, with its date. The four answers meet at one node, residue 614, one of the 299, set side by side with no verdict. The 26 structures are a chosen set, not RyR1's structures in general; the 299 residues are where at least one expert-panel record describes a single missense change, not every residue that matters. Nothing about any variant is inferred from these counts.
